description: This file defines the YearField class, which extends AbstractField and manages year-specific logic for cron scheduling, including validation, incrementing the date, and satisfaction checks based on the year value.

classes.name: YearField
classes.description: A class representing the year component in a cron expression, providing methods for validation, satisfaction testing, and date incrementing.

methods.name: isSatisfiedBy
methods.description: Checks if the given date satisfies the year condition specified by the cron expression.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Increments or decrements the date by one year, resetting to the start or end of the year accordingly.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the cron field value for correctness based on allowed characters.
